claim: For the Li–Wu–Zhang four-dimensional flow \(\dot x_1=a(x_2-x_1)+x_4\), \(\dot x_2=bx_1+x_2-x_1x_3\), \(\dot x_3=-cx_3+e^{x_1x_2}\), \(\dot x_4=dx_2x_3\), assume \(a>0\), \(c>0\), and \(b=1/c\). Its equilibrium line \(E_\xi=(\xi,0,1/c,a\xi)\) has the exactly factored characteristic polynomial \(\chi_\xi(\lambda)=\lambda(\lambda+a)(\lambda^2+(c-1)\lambda+\xi^2-c)\). Consequently its three transverse eigenvalues all have negative real part exactly when \(c>1\) and \(\xi^2>c\); when \(\xi^2<c\) there is one positive and one negative eigenvalue from the quadratic factor, at \(\xi^2=c\) an additional zero eigenvalue appears, for \(c=1\) and \(\xi^2>1\) the transverse pair is purely imaginary, and for \(0<c<1\) with \(\xi^2>c\) that pair has positive real part. No individual point of the line can be locally asymptotically stable because every neighborhood contains distinct equilibria. Thus the stability condition stated as Equation (7) in the source is not valid: at its own line-equilibrium parameters \(a=2\), \(b=3/8\), \(c=8/3\), \(d=0.1\), the point \(E_0\) satisfies the stated inequality but has spectrum \(\{0,-2,1,-8/3\}\), while the two numerically reported limiting points \(\xi\approx1.6385\) and \(\xi\approx2.0070\) lie in the actual transversely attracting region \(|\xi|>\sqrt{8/3}\); the latter even violates the source's stated inequality.
integrity: The equilibrium substitution, Jacobian determinant factorization, source-parameter counterexample, and rounded source examples were replayed by the packaged symbolic checker. The open-access primary full text was inspected directly for the equations, equilibrium line, characteristic polynomial, Equation (7), and the two reported limiting equilibria. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
limitations: The result is local to the equilibrium-line surface b=1/c and classifies transverse spectrum/normal attraction; it does not give global basins, point-selection along the line, or conclusions about the source's hyperchaotic parameter sets away from b=1/c. Targeted searches cannot exclude unindexed equivalent work.
title: Exact transverse-stability partition of an equilibrium line in an exponential hyperchaotic flow
